pivot.meaning: beam start at Field.x/y + 16 world units; endpoint remains Field.reach

runtimeTexture: 1536x512 shared GPU texture; 3MB RGBA, body/haze reuse it
blend: ADD body depth1 / source glow3 / actual hit contact4; danger lines NORMAL20 above all VFX

source.method: New neutral hot plasma body with branching filaments, irregular feathered alpha and pale cyan accents; no UI/weapon/scene; master copied unchanged; same-size WebP encoding

animation.body: width70% of declared beam width; same actual reach; small continuous intensity modulation using Combat.time
animation.flow: simulation-time-advection of fine streamers and particles
animation.charge: only pending beam actions with remaining <=0.4s
animation.contact: actual hit flashes whose positions lie inside an active opposite-side beam; cannot create damage
animation.end: fade in final0.15s while field is active; destroy when field removed
animation.lowEffects: one static body layer; hostile effective-width boundaries stay fully present; no haze/charge/contact/flow ornaments

logicBoundary: renderer only; does not change Field, damage, scheduling, collision, unit HP or RNG
